reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with Chrome DevTools MCP tools for real-browser navigation, interaction, inspection, scripting, network access, and performance analysis; its primary purpose is browser automation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Agent 提供基于 Chrome DevTools MCP 的真实浏览器导航、交互、页面检查、脚本执行和性能分析能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with Chrome DevTools MCP tools for real-browser navigation, interaction, page inspection, scripting, and performance analysis.

capabilities: Navigate and interact with real Chrome, Chromium, or Edge browsers
Read DOM snapshots, screenshots, console messages, network requests, and performance traces
Read and modify browser state including cookies and uploaded files
Send browser-originated network requests and access configured browser profiles
Share browser tabs and state across sessions and agents
